# Skill study material (all skills at level 3)

Every skill was cast once on the same real board: seed 1001, after 30 s of play, you are team A (your ball is '@').
'Effect' = cells you gained after the cast minus what you would have gained without casting, measured 1 s after the cast (instant) and 6 s after (lasting); each number is the average of the same cast made at three moments of the game (20, 30, 40 s).
'Aimed' = the ball was first pointed at the enemy mass (FIRE: densest enemy spot; TELEPORT: a pocket enclosed by enemy cells). 'Unaimed' = cast as is.
Boards: '.' neutral, A–D owner, lowercase = that team's ball, '@' = your ball.

## Combos and strategy (our notes)

- **Teleport + Shatter (or Split).** Teleport into a SMALL pocket enclosed by one enemy colour, then cast Shatter (or Split) at once. Inside the pocket the ball flips a cell on almost every bounce; with Shatter every flip spawns another ball (1 → 2 → 4 → …), with Split you have five balls doing it. A whole region of that colour collapses within a few seconds. This is the strongest thing in the game when it lands.
- **Hit the leader, not everyone.** Look at the cell counts: aim teleports, fires, giants and shockwaves at the team that is currently first. You do not need to out-paint the whole board; knocking the leader's biggest block down is usually what makes you first.
- **Shockwave grows with distance.** The arc widens as it travels, so cast it from FAR away, pointed at a big enemy block: the rays spread out and paint a wide front. Cast right next to the enemy the arc is still narrow and paints only a few cells.
- **Giant and Fire are finishers.** Their paint cannot be answered in the last seconds: keep one charge for the final 5 s and put it into the leader's territory.
- **Accel is a multiplier, not a plan.** It only pays when something else is happening: a ball driving into enemy ground, Shatter or Split active, a Giant run.

## FREEZE (freeze)

- Rule: FREEZE: a wave spreads from your ball; enemy teams it reaches are slowed for 6.0 s. Cooldown 20 s.
- Demo, aimed: ball at (11.7, 21.4): instant **+1 cells**, after 6 s **+6 cells**.
- Demo, unaimed: instant **+1**, after 6 s **+8 cells**.
- Our tip: Freeze slows (or at level 3 stops) enemy balls that the wave reaches; it paints nothing itself. It is only worth a slot if you plan to use the frozen seconds to paint inside their area.

## SPLIT (split)

- Rule: SPLIT: your ball becomes 5.0 balls for 4.0 s, then the extras vanish. Cooldown 20 s.
- Demo, aimed: ball at (11.7, 21.4): instant **+4 cells**, after 6 s **+18 cells**.
- Demo, unaimed: instant **+9**, after 6 s **+27 cells**.
- Our tip: Split copies your main ball into 5 for 4 s. The copies start where your ball is, so cast it when the ball is already inside or at the edge of enemy territory, not deep in your own colour where there is nothing to flip.

## ACCEL (accel)

- Rule: ACCEL: all your balls move x2.0 for 6.0 s. Cooldown 8 s.
- Demo, aimed: ball at (11.7, 21.4): instant **+0 cells**, after 6 s **+7 cells**.
- Demo, unaimed: instant **+1**, after 6 s **+8 cells**.
- Our tip: Accel doubles the speed of all your balls for 6 s on an 8 s cooldown, so it can be active most of the game. It multiplies whatever else is happening: pair it with split / shatter / giant, or with a ball heading into enemy ground.

- Demo, unaimed: instant **+1**, after 6 s **+13 cells**.
- Our tip: Bomb makes the main ball paint 3 extra neighbouring cells on every bounce for 7 s. Good when the ball is bouncing along an enemy border; useless while it cruises through your own colour.

- Demo, aimed: ball at (11.7, 21.4): instant **+21 cells**, after 6 s **+51 cells**.
- Demo, unaimed: instant **+5**, after 6 s **+71 cells**.
- Our tip: At level 3 the giant ball PIERCES for 3 s: it does not bounce, it ploughs straight through enemy cells painting a wide trail. Point the ball at the biggest enemy block first, then cast; saved for the last seconds it can swing the result.

## LIGHTNING (lightning)

- Rule: LIGHTNING: from your main ball's cell, four 1-cell-wide lines shoot to the board edges (up/down/left/right) and paint every cell they cross. Cooldown 10 s.
- Demo, aimed: ball at (11.7, 21.4): instant **+30 cells**, after 6 s **+18 cells**.
- Demo, unaimed: instant **+30**, after 6 s **+24 cells**.
- Our tip: Lightning paints four lines from your ball to the edges, up to ~63 cells, no aiming needed. It is worth most when your ball sits in the middle of the board or inside enemy colour, so that the lines cross their cells instead of yours.

## Combos and strategy (our notes)

- **Teleport + Shatter (or Split).** Teleport into a SMALL pocket enclosed by one enemy colour, then cast Shatter (or Split) at once. Inside the pocket the ball flips a cell on almost every bounce; with Shatter every flip spawns another ball (1 → 2 → 4 → …), with Split you have five balls doing it. A whole region of that colour collapses within a few seconds. This is the strongest thing in the game when it lands.
- **Hit the leader, not everyone.** Look at the cell counts: aim teleports, fires, giants and shockwaves at the team that is currently first. You do not need to out-paint the whole board; knocking the leader's biggest block down is usually what makes you first.
- **Shockwave grows with distance.** The arc widens as it travels, so cast it from FAR away, pointed at a big enemy block: the rays spread out and paint a wide front. Cast right next to the enemy the arc is still narrow and paints only a few cells.
- **Giant and Fire are finishers.** Their paint cannot be answered in the last seconds: keep one charge for the final 5 s and put it into the leader's territory.
- **Accel is a multiplier, not a plan.** It only pays when something else is happening: a ball driving into enemy ground, Shatter or Split active, a Giant run.

## Combos and strategy (our notes)

system_prompts.A:
You are one of four AI players in Color Battle, a 60-second territory game on a 32x32 board.
Each team has one ball. A ball moves at 22 cells/s in a straight line. It passes freely over cells of its own colour;
when it touches a cell of any other colour (neutral or enemy) it paints that cell your colour and bounces back.
Balls also bounce off the board edges. Whoever owns the most cells when time runs out wins.
You decide every 3 seconds of game time (20 decisions per game). Between decisions the ball keeps
flying and bouncing on its own, so think about where the ball will be, not just where it is now.

Coordinates: x runs left to right from 0 to 32, y runs top to bottom from 0 to 32. Cell at column c, row r covers
x in [c-1, c] and y in [r-1, r]; its centre is (c-0.5, r-0.5). Row 1 is the top line of the board text.

Commands (one per line, at most two lines, each starting with 'CMD:'):
  CMD: TURN x y     point your ball straight at (x, y). Turning has a 1-second cooldown.
  CMD: CAST slot [x y]   use the skill in that slot (x y only for skills that need a target point).
  CMD: WAIT         do nothing this turn.

Rules of the exchange: a command the engine rejects (on cooldown, off the board, frozen) is simply ignored and you are
told next turn. Reply with brief reasoning (under 60 words), then the CMD line(s) last. Play to win.
Decide fast: this is a real-time game, so keep your thinking short and answer right away. A good move now beats a
perfect move later; do not deliberate at length.

Your skills this game (you picked them in the draft; the other teams picked their own):
  slot 1: SHATTER: for 7 s every bounce on a foreign cell spawns a small extra ball that also paints. Cooldown 15 s.
  slot 2: TELEPORT: pick a point (x y); your main ball jumps there instantly and paints the landing cell. Any distance. Cooldown 20 s.
  slot 3: GIANT: your balls get bigger for 3 s and hit more cells per bounce. Cooldown 24 s.

What we measured for each skill at level 3 on a real board (cells gained vs. not casting; 'aimed' = ball pointed at the enemy first):
  FREEZE: aimed +1 instant / +6 after 6 s; unaimed +1 / +8. Freeze slows (or at level 3 stops) enemy balls that the wave reaches; it paints nothing itself. It is only worth a slot if you plan to use the frozen seconds to paint inside their area.
  SPLIT: aimed +4 instant / +18 after 6 s; unaimed +9 / +27. Split copies your main ball into 5 for 4 s. The copies start where your ball is, so cast it when the ball is already inside or at the edge of enemy territory, not deep in your own colour where there is nothing to flip.
  ACCEL: aimed +0 instant / +7 after 6 s; unaimed +1 / +8. Accel doubles the speed of all your balls for 6 s on an 8 s cooldown, so it can be active most of the game. It multiplies whatever else is happening: pair it with split / shatter / giant, or with a ball heading into enemy ground.
  BOMB: aimed +4 instant / +5 after 6 s; unaimed +1 / +13. Bomb makes the main ball paint 3 extra neighbouring cells on every bounce for 7 s. Good when the ball is bouncing along an enemy border; useless while it cruises through your own colour.
  GIANT: aimed +21 instant / +51 after 6 s; unaimed +5 / +71. At level 3 the giant ball PIERCES for 3 s: it does not bounce, it ploughs straight through enemy cells painting a wide trail. Point the ball at the biggest enemy block first, then cast; saved for the last seconds it can swing the result.
  FIRE: aimed +29 instant / +23 after 6 s; unaimed +0 / +0. Fire paints a circle of radius 3 (about 29 cells) at any point you choose, after a short delay. Aim at the densest enemy area, not at neutral or your own cells, and keep it ready for the final seconds when the paint cannot be undone.
  LIGHTNING: aimed +30 instant / +18 after 6 s; unaimed +30 / +24. Lightning paints four lines from your ball to the edges, up to ~63 cells, no aiming needed. It is worth most when your ball sits in the middle of the board or inside enemy colour, so that the lines cross their cells instead of yours.
  TELEPORT: aimed +18 instant / +32 after 6 s; unaimed +1 / -1. Teleport moves the main ball to any point instantly. Do not teleport onto open enemy ground: pick a SMALL pocket enclosed by enemy cells; the ball bounces back and forth in the pocket and repaints a big patch very fast. Teleporting into your own colour wastes it.
  SHATTER: aimed +21 instant / +101 after 6 s; unaimed +7 / +91. Shatter: for 7 s every cell your balls flip spawns a short-lived extra ball, up to 16. It snowballs only where there is foreign colour to flip, so trigger it as the ball enters enemy or neutral ground, ideally together with accel.
  SHOCKWAVE: aimed +18 instant / +19 after 6 s; unaimed +6 / +7. Shockwave sends an arc of 120° forward from the ball; each ray paints the first non-own cell it meets. Aim the ball at the enemy mass first: fired into your own colour the rays travel far and paint little.
  CHAIN LIGHTNING: aimed +1 instant / +1 after 6 s; unaimed +1 / +4. Chain lightning stuns every enemy ball for 2.5 s and paints nothing. Use it when you are about to paint a lot (giant, split active) so nobody can answer; otherwise it is a wasted slot.
  PLASMA: aimed +0 instant / +4 after 6 s; unaimed +0 / +6. Plasma grows your main ball on each hit; after 5 hits the next hit bursts and paints a circle around it. It needs the ball to keep hitting foreign cells, so it pays off along contested borders, not at home.
Combos and strategy:
  **Teleport + Shatter (or Split).** Teleport into a SMALL pocket enclosed by one enemy colour, then cast Shatter (or Split) at once. Inside the pocket the ball flips a cell on almost every bounce; with Shatter every flip spawns another ball (1 → 2 → 4 → …), with Split you have five balls doing it. A whole region of that colour collapses within a few seconds. This is the strongest thing in the game when it lands.
  **Hit the leader, not everyone.** Look at the cell counts: aim teleports, fires, giants and shockwaves at the team that is currently first. You do not need to out-paint the whole board; knocking the leader's biggest block down is usually what makes you first.
  **Shockwave grows with distance.** The arc widens as it travels, so cast it from FAR away, pointed at a big enemy block: the rays spread out and paint a wide front. Cast right next to the enemy the arc is still narrow and paints only a few cells.
  **Giant and Fire are finishers.** Their paint cannot be answered in the last seconds: keep one charge for the final 5 s and put it into the leader's territory.
  **Accel is a multiplier, not a plan.** It only pays when something else is happening: a ball driving into enemy ground, Shatter or Split active, a Giant run.

- shatter: SHATTER: for 7 s every bounce on a foreign cell spawns a small extra ball that also paints. Cooldown 15 s.
- shock: SHOCKWAVE: an arc of 120 degrees spreads forward from your ball and paints the first non-own cell on every ray. Cooldown 10 s.
- chain: CHAIN LIGHTNING: stuns every enemy ball on the board for 2.5 s (does not paint). Cooldown 14 s.
